scene: Living-room sofa in the evening. Dad sits at screen-left; Child sits beside him at screen-right, both with empty hands and relaxed postures. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: A warm, playful chat; Child shows small lively gestures while ranking his animals; both share gentle laughs.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Dad and Child sit side by side on the sofa with empty hands.
clips.action: Dad turns toward Child with his question. Child sits up straight and answers with one raised finger for his top pick.
clips.end: Both sit relaxed; Child's raised finger relaxes.

clips.start: Both sit relaxed on the sofa.
clips.action: Dad spreads one hand wide for 'every animal'. Child holds his hands far apart for big, then curves them into a gentle hug for the elephant babies.
clips.end: Child's hands return to his lap; Dad listens with a warm smile.

clips.start: Child's hands rest in his lap; Dad listens with a warm smile.
clips.action: Dad holds up two fingers for second-best. Child leans forward and mimes a penguin sliding with one flat hand. Dad asks his playful question with a grin; Child nods, then pats his own shoulders as if riding, and raises both arms in a small victory.
clips.end: Child sits back with a happy face; both laugh gently; hands return to their laps.
